DeepCool LS720S ZERO DARK 360mm Liquid CPU Cooler

The DeepCool LS720S ZERO DARK is a high-performance 360mm all-in-one liquid CPU cooler designed for powerful cooling with a clean, stealthy look. Featuring DeepCool’s 4th-Generation water pump, anti-leak technology, and three high-efficiency PWM fans, this AIO cooler ensures quiet operation and maximum thermal performance for modern Intel and AMD processors.

Key Features:

  • All-Black ZERO DARK Design – A sleek matte-black finish with subtle lighting for a minimalist, stealthy setup.

  • 4th Generation Water Pump – Advanced cooling engine with optimized microchannels and 3-phase motor up to 3100 RPM.

  • 360mm Radiator with Triple PWM Fans – Delivers superior airflow and static pressure with low noise.

  • Anti-Leak Technology – Automatically balances internal pressure to reduce risk of leaks and enhance safety.

  • Universal Compatibility – Supports Intel LGA 1700/1200/115x and AMD AM5/AM4 sockets.

  • Quiet & Durable Operation – Hydro bearing fans and premium build for long-lasting, silent cooling.

Specifications:

  • Radiator Size: 402 x 120 x 27 mm

  • Fan Speed: 500~2250 RPM ±10%

  • Airflow: 85.85 CFM per fan

  • Noise Level: ≤32.9 dB(A)

  • Pump Speed: 3100 RPM ±10%

  • Socket Support: Intel LGA1700/1200/1151/1150/1155, AMD AM5/AM4
